entries.zh: 绩效评估（两个词，第二个词 r 开头）

examples.en: My performance review is next month, so I'm collecting examples of my work.
examples.zh: 我下个月做绩效评估，所以在整理自己的工作案例。

situation.zh: 你想问经理：今年的绩效评估什么时候开始，需要你提前准备什么。
situation.en: When does the performance review cycle start, and what should I prepare?

entries.note: 口语里常简称 review 或 perf review。review cycle 指一轮评估周期，self-review 是自评。

entries.term: What would it take to get to the next level?
entries.zh: 要怎样才能升到下一级？

examples.en: I've been a senior engineer for two years. What would it take to get to the next level?
examples.zh: 我做高级工程师两年了。要怎样才能升到下一级？

situation.zh: 1:1 上你想直接问经理：你离晋升还差什么。
situation.en: What would it take to get to the next level? I'd like to know where the gaps are.

entries.note: 问晋升最得体的说法：不说“我该升了”，而是问标准和差距。level 指职级。

entries.zh: 提名……晋升

examples.en: My manager is going to put me up for promotion in the next cycle.
examples.zh: 我经理准备在下一轮提名我晋升。

situation.zh: 你想问经理：这一轮他会不会帮你提晋升。
situation.en: Do you think you could put me up for promotion this cycle?

entries.note: 晋升通常由经理提名。be up for promotion 指在候选之列，get promoted 才是真的升了。

entries.zh: 超出预期（绩效评级用语，e 开头的动词）

examples.en: I got an "exceeds expectations" rating this year, mostly because of the migration project.
examples.zh: 我今年的评级是“超出预期”，主要是因为迁移项目。

situation.zh: 你给下属做绩效反馈，想告诉他：这半年他的表现一直高于这个职级的要求。
situation.en: You've consistently exceeded expectations for your level this half.

entries.note: 绩效评级的固定说法，常见三档：below / meets / exceeds expectations。注意 meets expectations 是“合格”，不是批评。

entries.zh: 获得更多曝光、让更多人看到你的工作

examples.en: Presenting at the all-hands would help me get more visibility outside our team.
examples.zh: 在全员大会上做分享，能让团队以外更多的人看到我的工作。

situation.zh: 你做了很多幕后的基础设施工作，但别的团队不知道。你想跟经理商量怎么让成果被更多人看到。
situation.en: A lot of my work is behind the scenes. How can I get more visibility for it?

entries.note: visibility 指你的工作被上级和其他团队看见的程度，晋升时很重要。另一个意思是“知情”：give me visibility into the plan。

entries.zh: 薪酬（工资、奖金、股票的总称，c 开头）

examples.en: I'd like to talk about my compensation, given how much my scope has grown.
examples.zh: 考虑到我负责的范围扩大了很多，我想聊聊我的薪酬。

situation.zh: 你升职后工资一直没调。你想在 1:1 上正式提出来谈。
situation.en: I'd like to set aside some time to discuss my compensation.

entries.note: 比 salary 范围大，也更正式，口语简称 comp。total compensation（总包）包括 base salary、bonus 和 equity。

entries.zh: ……还有商量的余地吗？（f 开头的名词）

examples.en: Thank you for the offer. Is there any flexibility on the base salary?
examples.zh: 谢谢你们的 offer。基本工资还有商量的余地吗？

situation.zh: HR 给了你 offer，但入职日期比你希望的早。你想问能不能调整。
situation.en: Is there any flexibility on the start date? I need to give four weeks' notice.

entries.note: 谈 offer 的标准问法。不说 Can you pay more?，给对方留了台阶。on 后面接具体项目：salary、equity、start date。

entries.zh: 和市场水平相符

examples.en: I want to make sure my salary is in line with the market for this level.
examples.zh: 我想确认我的工资和这个职级的市场水平相符。

situation.zh: 你查了同级别的薪资数据，发现自己偏低。你想跟经理客观地提出来。
situation.en: From what I've seen, my pay isn't quite in line with the market for senior engineers.

entries.note: 谈加薪时拿市场数据说话，而不是“我觉得我值更多”。in line with 是“和……一致”。market rate 指市场价。

entries.term: I was hoping for something closer to ...
entries.zh: 我期望的数字更接近……（委婉还价）

examples.en: I appreciate the offer, but I was hoping for something closer to 150K.
examples.zh: 很感谢这个 offer，不过我期望的数字更接近 15 万。

situation.zh: 招聘方报的年薪比你预期低一成。你想礼貌地报出你的数字。
situation.en: Thanks for sharing the number. I was hoping for something closer to 180K.

entries.note: 过去进行时 was hoping 比 I want 委婉很多，是还价的常用句式。后面直接接数字。

entries.term: I'd like some time to think it over.
entries.zh: 我想花点时间仔细考虑一下。（最后一个词 o 开头）

examples.en: Thank you, this is exciting. I'd like some time to think it over.
examples.zh: 谢谢，这让我很兴奋。我想花点时间仔细考虑一下。

situation.zh: HR 在电话里口头给了 offer，希望你当场答复。你想礼貌地争取几天时间。
situation.en: I really appreciate it. I'd like some time to think it over. Could I get back to you by Friday?

entries.note: 不必当场答应或拒绝。think it over 是“仔细考虑”，比 think about it 郑重。给出明确的答复日期显得专业。

entries.zh: 我建议先从……入手

examples.en: I'd suggest starting with the read path, since it's simpler than the write path.
examples.zh: 我建议先从读路径入手，因为它比写路径简单。

situation.zh: 新人接手一个大模块，不知道从哪看起。你建议他先读集成测试。
situation.en: I'd suggest starting with the integration tests. They show how everything fits together.

entries.note: 给方向但不下命令。I'd suggest 比 You should 柔和，对方仍有自己判断的空间。suggest 后面接 -ing，不接 to do。

entries.zh: 我相信你的判断。（放手让对方决定）

examples.en: You know this codebase better than I do, so I trust your judgment.
examples.zh: 这套代码你比我熟，所以我相信你的判断。

situation.zh: 下属来问你该用哪个库，两个都行，你想让他自己定。
situation.en: Either one works. I trust your judgment on this.

entries.note: 放权时最有分量的一句话。美式拼写 judgment，英式常写 judgement。类似说法：It's your call.（你说了算。）

entries.zh: 你没问题的。/ 你能搞定。（鼓励，g 开头的动词）

examples.en: You've got this. You've done harder migrations than this one.
examples.zh: 你没问题的，比这更难的迁移你都做过。

situation.zh: 下属第一次要在全公司面前做演示，很紧张。上台前你想鼓励他。
situation.en: You've got this. You know the material better than anyone.

entries.note: 口语里的打气话，只用于关系比较近的同事。正式一点说 I have full confidence in you.

entries.term: This has come up a few times.
entries.zh: 这个问题已经出现好几次了。（指出反复发生的问题）

examples.en: This has come up a few times now, so I want us to talk about it.
examples.zh: 这个问题已经出现好几次了，所以我想我们得聊一聊。

situation.zh: 下属第三次没跑测试就合并代码，把主干搞挂了。你要严肃地指出这不是偶然。
situation.en: This has come up a few times. Can we talk about what's getting in the way?

entries.note: come up 是“出现、发生”。说的是事情反复出现，不说 You always ...，对事不对人，但分量已经不轻。

entries.zh: 我需要你……（明确提要求，语气较硬）

examples.en: I need you to let me know as soon as a deadline is at risk.
examples.zh: 一旦某个截止日期有风险，我需要你第一时间告诉我。

situation.zh: 下属几次延期都是最后一天才说。你要明确地提出要求：以后至少提前两天预警。
situation.en: Going forward, I need you to flag delays at least two days ahead.

entries.note: 语气强，是上级对下级提明确期望时用的，不留商量余地。平时请同事帮忙不要用，改用 Could you ...?

entries.zh: （长期高压后）身心俱疲、倦怠

examples.en: After three months of on-call every other week, I'm starting to feel burned out.
examples.zh: 连续三个月隔周值班之后，我开始觉得身心俱疲了。

situation.zh: 你连续加班赶了两个版本，现在对工作提不起劲。你想在 1:1 上跟经理坦白。
situation.en: To be honest, I'm feeling pretty burned out after the last two releases.

entries.note: 字面是“烧尽了”，名词是 burnout。比 tired 严重得多，指长期透支，说出来经理通常会认真对待。英式也拼 burnt out。

entries.zh: （事情太多）应付不过来、不堪重负，o 开头

examples.en: I'm a bit overwhelmed with all the requests coming in from different teams.
examples.zh: 各个团队提过来的需求太多，我有点应付不过来。

situation.zh: 你刚接手一个新系统，同时还要处理线上问题和招聘面试。你想告诉经理你快撑不住了。
situation.en: I'm feeling overwhelmed right now. There's just too much coming at me at once.

entries.note: 指被事情“淹没”的感觉，是眼下的状态；burned out 是长期透支的结果。加 a bit 可以减轻语气。

entries.zh: 这个节奏撑不下去。（s 开头的形容词）

examples.en: We've shipped every week for two months. This pace isn't sustainable.
examples.zh: 我们连着两个月每周都发版，这个节奏撑不下去。

situation.zh: 团队连续三个迭代都在加班赶进度。你想在 1:1 上提醒经理这样下去不行。
situation.en: This pace isn't sustainable. People are going to start making mistakes or leaving.

entries.note: sustainable 是“可持续的”。说的是节奏有问题，不是抱怨自己累，经理更容易接受。

entries.zh: 把……从我手头拿走（减轻工作量）

examples.en: Could someone take the release notes off my plate this week?
examples.zh: 这周能不能有人把发布说明这件事从我手头接走？

situation.zh: 你手上的事太多了，想请经理把代码评审值班这件事暂时转给别人。
situation.en: Would it be possible to take the review rotation off my plate for a while?

entries.note: 和 have a lot on my plate 是同一个比喻：盘子太满，拿走一些。请求调整工作量时很自然。

entries.zh: 休几天假

examples.en: I'm planning to take some time off after the launch to recharge.
examples.zh: 上线之后我打算休几天假，充充电。

situation.zh: 你最近状态很差，想跟经理说你需要休息一周。
situation.en: I think I need to take some time off. Would the week after next work?

entries.note: time off 泛指不上班的时间。不用解释原因，说 I need to recharge 就够了。

entries.zh: 公开点名表扬（某人）

examples.en: I want to give a shout-out to Priya for fixing the flaky tests.
examples.zh: 我想公开表扬一下 Priya，她把那些不稳定的测试修好了。

situation.zh: 周会上你想当众感谢 Leo：他周末加班把数据修复了。
situation.en: Before we start, I want to give a shout-out to Leo for fixing the data over the weekend.

entries.note: shout-out 字面是“喊一嗓子”，指当众点名感谢。口语里常省成 Shout-out to Leo for ...

entries.zh: 为……点赞、向……致敬（K 开头）

examples.en: Kudos to the infra team for a smooth migration with zero downtime.
examples.zh: 为基础设施团队点赞，这次迁移很顺利，零停机。

situation.zh: 上线很成功，你想在团队群里夸一下负责发布的 Ana。
situation.en: Kudos to Ana for running such a clean release!

entries.note: kudos 来自希腊语，意思是“荣誉、赞扬”。它看着像复数，其实是不可数名词，没有 a kudo 的说法。多用于书面和群聊。

entries.term: I couldn't have done it without ...
entries.zh: 没有……我做不成这件事

examples.en: I couldn't have done it without Wei's help on the database side.
examples.zh: 数据库这边没有 Wei 帮忙，我做不成这件事。

situation.zh: 经理在会上表扬你把性能优化做成了。你想把一部分功劳归给帮你做压测的 Sam。
situation.en: Thanks, but I couldn't have done it without Sam. He ran all the load tests.

entries.note: 被表扬时把功劳分给帮过你的人，是英文职场很看重的习惯。

entries.zh: 做得远超本分、格外尽心

examples.en: She went above and beyond to help the new hires get set up.
examples.zh: 为了帮新同事把环境搭好，她做的远远超出了本分。

situation.zh: 你写绩效评语，想说 Tom 在事故期间主动熬夜帮别的团队排查，做的远超职责要求。
situation.en: Tom went above and beyond during the incident, helping another team debug overnight.

entries.note: 夸人很有分量，常出现在绩效评语和感谢信里。完整说法是 above and beyond the call of duty（超出职责的要求）。

entries.zh: 把……的功劳归于（某人）

examples.en: I want to give Mei credit for the idea. I just implemented it.
examples.zh: 这个主意的功劳要归 Mei，我只是把它实现了。

situation.zh: 大家以为缓存方案是你想出来的，其实是实习生提的。你想在会上说清楚。
situation.en: I have to give our intern credit for this. The caching idea was hers.

entries.note: credit 是“功劳”。反过来，take credit for 是把功劳揽到自己身上，常带贬义。
